cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Say You Saw It Too
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit noticing the impossible detail before you reveal how much you believe it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before you send this soup back, did you notice anything moving?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm complaining about cold noodles. What did you see?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Tell me whether one waved. I need your word before I explain.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It waved me closer. I'm still not eating it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'll understand why I've ordered it lunch. Could you ask whether it wants your bread?

mechanism: A corrects a diner's complaint priorities to obtain a precise impossible observation before revealing that A has already treated the noodle as a guest.
confusable: Simply normalizing magic differs from D160's staged admission: A's commitment must wait for B's confirmation.
comparison: A customer complaint and feeding choice differ from an independent witness chronology.
seedUse: Keep cold noodles, wave confirmation and ordered lunch; make A's correction about the actual complaint sequence.
